lines.en: label sanaspring4:
scene knifeboy1
Sana Sakakibara was out for a late night stroll.
lines.zh: Sana Sakakibara 正在深夜散步。

lines.en: It was a thing she did sometimes when it was hard for her to sleep.
lines.zh: 这是她偶尔会做的事，在她难以入睡的时候。

lines.en: It never made her tired or anything of the sort. In fact, I’d say it did the opposite.
lines.zh: 它从没让她觉得累，或者任何类似的感觉。事实上，我倒觉得它起到的是反作用。

lines.en: But I guess there’s no reason for you to trust my word when you don’t even know who I am.
lines.zh: 不过既然你连我是谁都不知道，大概也没理由信我的话。

lines.en: Regardless, here she was, retracing the same steps as always in a lap around a block she’d never visited in the daytime.
lines.zh: 无论如何，她就在这儿，一如既往地重走着同一条路线，绕着一个她白天从未来过的街区转圈。

lines.en: But something about the way it looked at night excited her, so she kept coming back.
lines.zh: 但它在夜晚的样子让她莫名兴奋，所以她一直回来。

lines.en: The dark alleys and how those gaping mouths of black would unsuccessfully beckon her in — the overwhelming silence that made her footsteps echo throughout those moonlit, concrete caverns.
lines.zh: 那些黑暗的小巷，还有那些张开的黑色大嘴如何徒劳地招手唤她进去——那种压倒性的寂静，让她的脚步声在月光照耀的水泥洞穴里回荡。

lines.en: She gazed down at her phone, her thumb darting up and down and up and down as she tried to come up with an excuse as to why she’d call a certain someone at a certain time of night.
lines.zh: 她低头看着手机，拇指上上下下、上上下下地划着，想编出一个理由，解释自己为什么要在深夜的某个时刻打给某个特定的人。

lines.en: She never did, though.
lines.zh: 可她从来没打过。

lines.en: She’d gone through the trouble of asking her roommate for his number, but the only time she ever got any use out of it was during a desperate plea for him to come and quell her hormones.
lines.zh: 她费了好大劲才从室友那儿要到他的号码，而它唯一派上用场的一次，是她绝望地求他过来平息她的荷尔蒙。

lines.en: It wasn’t always like this, though. There wasn’t always indecision or curiosity or {i}excitement{/i}.
lines.zh: 不过从前并不总是这样。从前并不总是有犹豫、好奇和{i}兴奋{/i}。

lines.en: But there was always fear.
lines.zh: 但一直都有恐惧。

lines.en: A long, long time ago — she was normal.
lines.zh: 很久很久以前——她是个正常人。

lines.en: But the night’s infinite reach claimed her heart and put an end to that innocence from miles away in a place just like this one.
lines.zh: 可夜色那无远弗届的手攫住了她的心，从几英里外、在一个和这里一模一样的地方，终结了那份天真。

lines.en: It was that thought that made it impossible to be comforted here. It was {i}that{/i} thought that prevented her from ever getting tired no matter {i}how{/i} far she walked.
lines.zh: 正是{i}这个{/i}念头，让她无法在这里得到安慰。正是这个念头，让她无论走{i}多{/i}远都不会累。

lines.en: She taps on his name.
lines.zh: 她点下他的名字。

lines.en: scene knifeboy2
She changes her mind.
lines.zh: 她改了主意。

lines.en: She taps it again.
lines.zh: 她又点了一次。

lines.en: She changes her mind {i}again.{/i}
lines.zh: 她{i}又{/i}改了主意。

lines.en: It was like a one-sided game of phone tag where {i}she{/i} was never {i}it.{/i}
lines.zh: 这就像一场单方面的电话捉人游戏，而{i}她{/i}从来都不是那个“{i}鬼{/i}”。

lines.en: But she would be one day. And that day couldn’t come soon enough.
lines.zh: 但总有一天她会是。而那一天来得越早越好。

lines.en: scene knifeboy3
She looks up at the top of the tallest building on the block, wondering how long it would take to fall from its peak to the ground below.
lines.zh: 她抬头看向这条街上最高的那栋楼的楼顶，想知道从楼顶坠到下面的地面需要多久。

lines.en: She didn’t want to die. She just wanted to know what death felt like. She wanted to know if there really {i}was{/i} an afterlife or if everything just went dark.
lines.zh: 她并不想死。她只是想知道死亡是什么感觉。她想知道死后是否真的{i}有{/i}来世，还是说一切都只是归于黑暗。

lines.en: : Psst...
scene knifeboy4
It was a reasonable thought everyone has from time to time.
lines.zh: 这是个合理的念头，每个人时不时都会有。

lines.en: scene knifeboy5
It was only exacerbated by what she saw next.
lines.zh: 而她接下来看到的东西，让这个念头更加强烈了。

lines.en: scene knifeboy6
: Wha-
: They say my limbs are long enough to reach the sky and back.
lines.zh: : 他们说我的四肢长得能够到天空再绕回来。

lines.en: : What do you think about that?
lines.zh: : 你觉得呢？

lines.en: : I have seen you before.
lines.zh: : 我以前见过你。

lines.en: : You wander these streets with that block in your hand.
lines.zh: : 你拿着那块砖头在这一带游荡。

lines.en: : You always look delicious.
lines.zh: : 你看起来总是很美味。

lines.en: : Who is it you think of when the glow hits your face?
lines.zh: : 当那道光打在你脸上时，你想的是谁？

lines.en: scene knifeboy7
: Oh no...
lines.zh: : 哦不……

lines.en: : It’s happening again...
lines.zh: : 又来了……

lines.en: Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara. Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara?
lines.zh: Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara. Sana Sakakibara Sana Sakakibara?

lines.en: : They call me the tree tickler. My fingers are perfect for that sort of thing.
lines.zh: : 他们叫我挠树者。我的手指最适合干那种事。

lines.en: : Go away.
lines.zh: : 走开。

lines.en: : Perhaps you’d like to feel their sting?
lines.zh: : 也许你想尝尝它们蜇人的滋味？

lines.en: : You aren’t real...
lines.zh: : 你不是真的……

lines.en: : This isn’t actually happening...
lines.zh: : 这根本没有在发生……

lines.en: scene knifeboy8
: I’m as real as rhubarb. I come bearing gifts.
lines.zh: : 我像大黄一样真实。我带着礼物而来。

lines.en: : A palace, a portal, five bundles of sticks.
lines.zh: : 一座宫殿，一道传送门，五捆树枝。

lines.en: : Won’t you enter my alley? I think we’d be fast friends.
lines.zh: : 你愿不愿意进我的巷子？我觉得我们会成为好朋友的。

lines.en: scene knifeboy9
: Ngh! Stop! Go...AWaY!!!
Her finger presses her temple presses her temple presses her temple because that sort of thing helps with headaches.
lines.zh: 她的手指按着太阳穴按着太阳穴按着太阳穴，因为那一类动作对头痛有帮助。

lines.en: Things that don’t belong suddenly do. And things that do suddenly don’t.
lines.zh: 不该存在的东西突然就存在了。而该存在的东西突然就不存在了。

lines.en: Remember the rabbits. Remember his chest. Remember his heartbeat and and and remember the REST {s}SANA should be in BED{/s}
lines.zh: 记住那些兔子。记住他的胸膛。记住他的心跳，还有、还有、还有记住剩下的 {s}SANA 该在床上{/s}了

lines.en: : I have just the thing for that. A medicine that cures. Every sorrowful thought you ever did think, it’s a drink to make you pure.
lines.zh: : 我正好有治那个的东西。一种能治病的药。你所想过的每一个悲伤的念头，它都是一杯让你变纯洁的饮料。

lines.en: : Won’t you enter my alley? I think we’d be fast friends.
lines.zh: : 你愿不愿意进我的巷子？我觉得我们会成为好朋友的。

lines.en: : I have to...call someone! Before I...ngh!
lines.zh: : 我得……打电话给谁！趁我……嗯！

lines.en: Her head hurt. That’s what all of the “ngh”s were about.
lines.zh: 她的头很痛。那些“嗯”全都是因为这个。

lines.en: GODNOTE: NGH stands for New Generational Height — the place she would soon reach.
lines.zh: 神注：NGH 是「新世代高度」（New Generational Height）的缩写——她很快就要抵达的地方。

lines.en: To the sky and back she flew.
lines.zh: 她飞向天空，又飞了回来。

lines.en: scene knifeboy10
: Come on, SSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSANA. It only hurts the first time.
lines.zh: : 来吧，SSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSSANA。只有第一次会疼。

lines.en: : There’s an empty space not far from here.
lines.zh: : 离这儿不远有个空地方。

lines.en: : A place to turn the clock back.
lines.zh: : 一个把时钟拨回去的地方。

lines.en: : Your presence is requested.
lines.zh: : 请您莅临。

lines.en: : I will deliver you to the to the to the to the dream world.
lines.zh: : 我会把你送到、送到、送到、送到梦境世界。

lines.en: : You will will will will {b}REMEMBER TO SMILE.{/b}
lines.zh: : 你会、会、会、会{b}记得要微笑{/b}。

lines.en: : S...Sensei!...{i}Help...me!...{/i}
scene knifeboy11
: Don’t worry, Sana! I’m here to help! And it looks like I showed up just in time!
lines.zh: : 别担心，Sana！我来帮忙了！而且看来我出现得正是时候！

lines.en: : Sensei! You can fly?!
lines.zh: : 老师！你会飞？！

lines.en: : Face me, evildoer! I shan’t allow the tickling of {i}these{/i} trees! You haven’t filed for the appropriate permits!
lines.zh: : 面对我吧，邪恶之徒！我不允许你挠{i}这些{/i}树！你根本没申请相应的许可证！

lines.en: : Yes I have.
lines.zh: : 我申请了。

lines.en: scene knifeboy12
: Oh, okay then.
lines.zh: : 哦，那好吧。

lines.en: : Sorry, Sana. This is out of my hands.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Sana。这事我管不了了。

lines.en: : Nooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo~
scene knifeboy8
: There’s no need to cry, young one. You’ll be safer under artificial skies.
lines.zh: : 不必哭泣，年轻人。在人造的天空下你会更安全。

lines.en: : They’ll protect you from the rain.
lines.zh: : 它们会替你挡雨。

lines.en: : You won’t ever want to leave.
lines.zh: : 你会永远不想离开。

lines.en: : Ngh...no! This...isn’t happening! None of this...is real!
lines.zh: : 嗯……不！这……没有在发生！这些……都不是真的！

lines.en: : When will you ever believe?
lines.zh: : 你到底要到什么时候才会相信？

lines.en: : Leave me...alone!
lines.zh: : 离我……远点！

lines.en: : I hope you brought your swimsuit.
lines.zh: : 希望你带了泳衣。

lines.en: : It’s time to get wet.
lines.zh: : 是时候湿身了。

lines.en: scene sploosh
scene knifeboy13
: If you could build your own world, what would it look like?
lines.zh: : 如果你能建造自己的世界，它会是什么样子？

lines.en: : Would you decorate it with your favorite colors and designs? Or would you try to create a place where {i}everyone{/i} would be happy instead of just you?
lines.zh: : 你会用自己最喜欢的颜色和图案装饰它吗？还是说你会试着创造一个让{i}所有人{/i}都幸福、而不只是你幸福的地方？

lines.en: : If it were up to me...I think I’d be selfish. But that doesn’t make me a bad person, does it?
lines.zh: : 如果由我来决定……我想我会很自私。但那不代表我是坏人，对吧？

lines.en: : Everyone else would eventually get used to the colors I chose. And in a world where everyone is happy, I’m sure people would still find something to be sad about.
lines.zh: : 其他人终究会习惯我选的颜色。而在一个所有人都幸福的世界里，我敢肯定人们还是会找到可以悲伤的东西。

lines.en: : Like...look at you, Sensei. If this world is as infinite as you and Ayane claim it to be, what’s stopping you from spending each and every day just having fun?
lines.zh: : 比如……看看你，老师。如果这个世界真像你和 Ayane 声称的那样无限，那有什么能阻止你每天都只顾着玩乐？

lines.en: : I hope you guys are right...Life seems way easier without something to worry about. And if I could go back any time things started to go on for too long, well...
lines.zh: : 我希望你们说的是对的……没有可担心的东西，人生看起来容易多了。而如果事情一拖得太久我就能回去重来，那么……

lines.en: : I just think that would help keep the parts of me I’m afraid of away for longer than I’m able to do on my own.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，那样能把我害怕的那部分自己挡在外面，比我一个人撑着要久。

lines.en: : But, then again...
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来……

lines.en: scene knifeboy14
: If that were the case, we’d never make it to that future where-
lines.zh: : 如果是那样，我们就永远到不了那个未来，在——

lines.en: scene knifeboy15
scene knifeboy16
scene knifeboy17
Sana Sakakibara was not where she thought she was. But she never should have thought she was somewhere she wasn’t.
lines.zh: Sana Sakakibara 不在她以为自己所在的地方。但她从来就不该以为自己在一个她并不在的地方。

lines.en: More things that don’t belong suddenly do. More things that do suddenly don’t. So when things become another thing they become another thing and then another and then they’re gone.
lines.zh: 更多不该存在的东西突然就存在了。更多该存在的东西突然就不存在了。所以当东西变成另一个东西，它们就变成另一个东西，然后再另一个，然后它们就不见了。

lines.en: That’s where we are now — a place that isn’t on top of a place that is, full of beings who aren’t when they think that they are.
lines.zh: 我们现在就在那里——一个不在“是”的地方之上的地方，住满了自以为是、其实并不是的存在。

lines.en: Sana Sakakibara had fallen through the map and wound up in another realm — a place where dreams come prior to sleep. But that’s only because it’s a place that sleep has not found yet.
lines.zh: Sana Sakakibara 从地图上掉了下去，掉进了另一个领域——一个梦在入睡之前到来的地方。但那只是因为，那是一个睡眠还没找到的地方。

lines.en: scene knifeboy18
: Sana Sakakibara — your attendance is required for the Transpacific Sadness Symposium in four days.
lines.zh: : Sana Sakakibara——请您在四天后出席跨太平洋悲伤研讨会。

lines.en: : The current temperature is sixty-five degrees Fahrenheit. The time of day is to be determined shortly.
lines.zh: : 当前气温为六十五华氏度。时间将于稍后确定。

lines.en: : Until then, feel free to make yourself comfortable somewhere between darkness and daytime. Refreshments will be provided momentarily.
lines.zh: : 在此之前，请随意在黑暗与白昼之间的某处安顿下来。茶点稍后奉上。

lines.en: : ...what?
: In order to replicate the critical success of “Ad Infinitum,” a familiar song will now play on repeat through the loudspeaker. Though it may not be familiar to you.
lines.zh: : 为重现《Ad Infinitum》的关键性成功，下面将通过扩音器循环播放一首熟悉的歌。不过对你来说也许并不熟悉。

lines.en: : Please take a seat on the bench and wait patiently for your number to be called. Your guide will be arriving shortly.
lines.zh: : 请在长椅上就座，耐心等候叫号。您的向导即将抵达。

lines.en: scene knifeboy19
She could not believe her eyes or her ears or her mouth. This was insanity. This was crazy. This was super fucking weird. It was chaos. Madness. Other negative adjectives!
lines.zh: 她不敢相信自己的眼睛、耳朵和嘴巴。这是疯了。这是疯了。这是超级他妈的诡异。这是混乱。疯狂。以及其他负面形容词！

lines.en: There was no wind, just the faint smell of chlorine as music bounced off of expertly painted walls (or wall?) of a dome that held her like the unmoving nucleus of a cruel joke.
lines.zh: 没有风，只有淡淡的氯气味，音乐从一座穹顶那刷得极为专业的墙壁（或者墙？）上弹回来，而那座穹顶像一句残酷玩笑里静止的细胞核一样把她盛在里面。

lines.en: Right now, she was the unborn child of reality itself, wriggling and {i}thinking{/i} on the floor of Earth’s uterus. She did not know what was approaching for the silence had already settled in.
lines.zh: 此刻，她是现实本身尚未出生的孩子，在地球的子宫地板上蠕动着、{i}思考{/i}着。她不知道有什么正在靠近，因为寂静已经落定了。

lines.en: : I’m going fucking insane.
lines.zh: : 我要他妈的发疯了。

lines.en: She wasn’t. This was REAL. Super real! That’s why other people kept experiencing it! But she didn’t know that yet. She doesn’t know anything yet because she isn’t ALLOWED TO. She is SUPPRESSED.
lines.zh: 她没有。这是真的。超级真！正因为如此，其他人才会一直经历它！可她还不知道这个。她还什么都不知道，因为她不被允许知道。她被压制了。

lines.en: Reach forward! Touch the walls! Feel that wet lead paint on your fingertips before bringing to your lips and painting them blue only for your skin to follow suit! Skin suit! Special Ami! She is here!
lines.zh: 往前伸！去摸那些墙！感受指尖上那湿漉漉的铅漆，再把它送到唇边，把嘴唇涂成蓝色，接着皮肤也跟着变色！皮套装！特别版 Ami！她来了！

lines.en: : TURN
lines.zh: : 转身

lines.en: scene knifeboy20
NEVERMIND IT’S SOMEONE ELSE OH SHIT
lines.zh: : 算了是别人 哦操

lines.en: : Wha-
: FEAST YOUR EYES UPON MY TRUER FORM.
lines.zh: : 瞻仰我更真实的形态吧。

lines.en: : I RETURN IN A REALM OF MY OWN, MORE POWERFUL THAN I WAS BEFORE. SO WHY IS IT YOU HAVE GROWN WEAKER?
lines.zh: : 我在一个属于我自己的领域里归来，比从前更强大。那么为何你却变得更弱了？

lines.en: : WHY HAVE YOU CHANGED? WHY ARE YOU LESS SUITED?
lines.zh: : 你为何变了？你为何不再合适了？

lines.en: : Who are you?...
lines.zh: : 你是谁？……

lines.en: : And why do I keep seeing things like this?...
lines.zh: : 还有为什么我一直看到这种东西？……

lines.en: : I AM PEGASUS, PEERLESS GOD OF FORGIVENESS. YOU SEE ONLY WHAT YOU ARE MEANT TO SEE AND NOTHING MORE OR LESS.
lines.zh: : 我是 PEGASUS，无与伦比的宽恕之神。你只看到你该看到的，不多也不少。

lines.en: : WERE YOU TICKLED BY THE TICKLER? DO YOU NEED TO BE CLEANSED? IS THAT WHY I CAN SEE YOU CLEARER THAN BEFORE????
lines.zh: : 你被挠树者挠过了吗？你需要被净化吗？这就是我比从前能更清楚地看到你的原因吗？？？？

lines.en: : SPEAK, WEAK ONE. SPEAK THE WORDS YOUR WHORE MOTHER SPOKE WHEN PLUCKING FEATHERS FROM MY EIGHTH WING. DO NOT BE SWALLOWED BY THE EQUAL TASTE OF FEAR.
lines.zh: : 说话吧，弱者。说出你那个妓女母亲从我第八只翅膀上拔羽毛时所说的话。别被恐惧那等量的滋味吞下去。

lines.en: : I would like to go home now, Mr. Pegasus.
lines.zh: : 我想回家了，Pegasus 先生。

lines.en: : YOU CAN NOT LEAVE BEFORE ATTENDING THE SYMPOSIUM. I HAVE FOUR DAYS TO LOCK YOUR HEART IN MY CAGE.
lines.zh: : 出席研讨会之前你不能走。我有四天时间把你的心锁进我的笼子。

lines.en: : NOW SPREAD YOUR FUCKING LEGS AND LET ME IN.
lines.zh: : 现在把你的腿他妈的张开，让我进去。

lines.en: : I don’t think it will fit, Mr. Pegasus.
lines.zh: : 我觉得它进不去的，Pegasus 先生。

lines.en: : YOU DON’T FEAR ME AT ALL, DO YOU?
lines.zh: : 你一点也不怕我，是吗？

lines.en: : I don’t think I’m coherent enough to feel fear right now...
lines.zh: : 我觉得我现在还不够清醒，感觉不到恐惧……

lines.en: : Either that or I just fell asleep in the middle of the road.
lines.zh: : 要么就是我刚才在马路中间睡着了。

lines.en: : YOU THINK ME A DREAM, WEAKLING? YOU DARE DOUBT THE PRESENCE OF A PEERLESS ONE? DO YOU NOT UNDERSTAND HOW EASY IT WOULD BE FOR ME TO ERASE YOU?
lines.zh: : 你以为我是梦吗，弱者？你竟敢怀疑一位无与伦比者的存在？你难道不明白抹掉你对我来说有多容易吗？

lines.en: : Do it then.
lines.zh: : 那就动手啊。

lines.en: : You want something from me, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你想要我身上的什么东西，对吧？

lines.en: : All of you do. That’s why you keep showing up. That’s why you keep trying to take me.
lines.zh: : 你们全都想要。所以你们才一直出现。所以你们才一直想把我带走。

lines.en: : I have something you want. But...you don’t have anything for me, do you?
lines.zh: : 我有你们想要的东西。可是……你们拿不出任何东西给我，对吧？

lines.en: : THAT IS WHERE YOU ARE WRONG, CHILD.
lines.zh: : 孩子，你错就错在这里。

lines.en: : ANYTHING YOU NAME SHALL BE YOURS IF YOU PLEDGE YOURSELF TO ME. YOU NEED ONLY SPREAD YOUR LEGS AND SPEAK THE WORD.
lines.zh: : 只要你向我宣誓，你所说出的任何东西都将归你所有。你只需张开双腿，说出那个词。

lines.en: : I want my teacher to fall in love with me.
lines.zh: : 我想让我的老师爱上我。

lines.en: : I DON’T MAKE DEALS WITH LESBIANS.
lines.zh: : 我不和女同性恋做交易。

lines.en: : The other one. The one who doesn’t come to school anymore.
lines.zh: : 另一个。那个不再来上学的。

lines.en: : If you’re saying you’ll grant me a wish, I wish for him to fall in love with me and for everyone else to give up. Can you make that happen?
lines.zh: : 如果你说你会实现我的愿望，那我希望他爱上我，其他所有人都放弃。你能做到吗？

lines.en: : WHY HIM?
lines.zh: : 为什么是他？

lines.en: : Can you make it happen or not?
lines.zh: : 你到底能不能做到？

lines.en: : REMOVE YOUR CLOTHING AND LIE IN THE SAND. I WILL FILL YOU WITH A FLUID YOU MAY FEED TO HIM WHEN THE TIME IS RIGHT.
lines.zh: : 脱掉衣服，躺在沙子里。我会用一种液体填满你，等时机成熟你再喂给他。

lines.en: : BUT DO IT QUICKLY OR-
lines.zh: : 但要快，否则——

lines.en: : You shouldn’t listen to him. He’s lying to you.
lines.zh: : 你不该听他的。他在骗你。

lines.en: scene knifeboy21
: KNIFE BOY! YOU HAVE STUCK YOUR NOSE WHERE IT DOES NOT BELONG ONCE MORE! DO NOT BELITTLE ME WHEN YOU YOURSELF CAN NOT EVEN SEE THE LIGHT.
lines.zh: : 小刀男孩！你又一次把鼻子伸进了不属于你的地方！你连光都看不见，就别来贬低我。

lines.en: : Hello. I will be your guide today. Are you ready for a tour of the school?
lines.zh: : 你好。今天由我来做你的向导。准备好参观学校了吗？

lines.en: : YOU DARE IGNORE ME, SHUNNED ONE?
lines.zh: : 你竟敢无视我，被放逐者？

lines.en: : I WILL NEVER FORGIVE YOU.
lines.zh: : 我绝不会原谅你。

lines.en: The two-headed horse vanishes, leaving Sana Sakakibara alone with Knife Boy, the Shunned.
lines.zh: 双头马消失了，留下 Sana Sakakibara 和小刀男孩——被放逐者——单独在一起。

lines.en: But while he is here to provide a service and give her a tour of the school, Sana Sakakibara does not budge.
lines.zh: 虽然他是来提供服务、带她参观学校的，Sana Sakakibara 却一步也不动。

lines.en: scene knifeboy22
Probably because she recognizes his voice and is more in shock now than she was after seeing the God of Forgiveness.
lines.zh: 大概是因为她认出了他的声音，而此刻她比看到宽恕之神时更震惊。

lines.en: : Shota?...
lines.zh: : Shota？……

lines.en: : Are you ready for a tour of the school?
lines.zh: : 准备好参观学校了吗？

lines.en: : Shota...
lines.zh: : Shota……

lines.en: : Do you...
: Not remember me?...
lines.zh: : 不记得我了吗？……

lines.en: : I remember you.
lines.zh: : 我记得你。

lines.en: : How could I ever forget my sister?
lines.zh: : 我怎么会忘了自己的妹妹？

lines.en: scene knifeboy23
: It’s really you then?! What are you doing here?! Is this Heaven?! Are you-
lines.zh: : 真的是你？！你在这儿干什么？！这里是天堂吗？！你是——

lines.en: scene knifeboy24
: Wait, did I {i}die?{/i} Why can I see you?
lines.zh: : 等等，我{i}死{/i}了吗？为什么我能看见你？

lines.en: : I’m not supposed to answer any questions that aren’t related to the tour.
lines.zh: : 我不该回答任何与参观无关的问题。

lines.en: scene knifeboy25

: Forget what you’re supposed to do! I’ve been hearing your voice for so long and now I actually get to {i}see{/i} you! Also, have you really been watching me this whole time? Because that’s super creepy.
lines.zh: : 管它该干什么呢！我听你的声音听了那么久，现在终于能真的{i}见到{/i}你了！还有，你真的从头到尾都在看着我吗？因为那真是超级变态。

lines.en: : I’m not supposed to answer any questions that aren’t related to the tour.
lines.zh: : 我不该回答任何与参观无关的问题。

lines.en: : What...happens if you do?
lines.zh: : 如果……你回答了会怎样？

lines.en: : They add a knife for every rule I break. It really hurts. Are you ready for a tour of the school now?
lines.zh: : 我每破一条规矩，他们就插一把刀。真的很疼。你现在准备好参观学校了吗？

lines.en: scene knifeboy26
: What {i}school{/i} do you keep talking about? It’s just water and old furniture here.
lines.zh: : 你说的{i}学校{/i}到底是什么？这儿只有水和旧家具。

lines.en: : The one beneath the surface. We have to swim there.
lines.zh: : 水面之下的那所。我们得游过去。

lines.en: : It’s where they’re holding the Symposium. You won’t want to miss it.
lines.zh: : 研讨会就在那儿举行。你不会想错过的。

lines.en: : It’s supposed to be a lot of fun this year. Several high-ranking gods from the Head Office are-
lines.zh: : 据说今年会很好玩。总部来的好几位高阶神明都——

lines.en: : Shota, why don’t you just take the knives out?
lines.zh: : Shota，你为什么不干脆把刀拔出来？

lines.en: scene knifeboy21
: Take them out?
lines.zh: : 拔出来？

lines.en: : Yeah. If they hurt so much, why don’t you just take them out?
lines.zh: : 对啊。既然那么疼，为什么不干脆拔出来？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Maybe that’s against the rules too?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。也许那也违反规矩？

lines.en: : It’d be really depressing to take {i}one{/i} out just for another one to be added in.
lines.zh: : 拔掉{i}一把{/i}、又补进来一把，那也太让人沮丧了。

lines.en: : Do you want me to help?
lines.zh: : 要我帮忙吗？

lines.en: : You probably shouldn’t. The school is really big and if you don’t get familiar with it soon, you could stay lost in there forever.
lines.zh: : 你大概不该帮。学校很大，你要是不快点熟悉起来，可能会永远在里面迷路。

lines.en: : Four days is plenty of time! Let’s talk! {i}Actually{/i} talk! So much has happened lately and I don’t want to regret not telling you anything before I wake up!
lines.zh: : 四天时间绰绰有余！我们聊聊吧！{i}真的聊聊{/i}！最近发生了好多事，我不想在醒来之前后悔什么都没告诉你！

lines.en: : Mom misses you too, Shota. She still can’t even talk about what happened. But maybe if she knows you’re in here, she-
lines.zh: : 妈妈也想你，Shota。她到现在都没法提起那件事。但也许如果她知道你在这里面，她——

lines.en: : I don’t like Mom anymore.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢妈妈了。

lines.en: : ...What?
: She’s the reason I’m shunned here.
lines.zh: : 我在这里被放逐，就是因为她。

lines.en: : They always talk about how she broke the rules and how much of a {i}whore{/i} she is.
lines.zh: : 他们总在说她怎么破了规矩，说她是个多不要脸的{i}妓女{/i}。

lines.en: : Are you becoming a whore too, Sana? Is that why you do that thing with your fingers all the time?
lines.zh: : 你也要变成妓女了吗，Sana？所以你才老是用手指做那种事？

lines.en: : So...you {i}have{/i} been watching.
lines.zh: : 所以……你{i}一直{/i}都在看。

lines.en: : What does it feel like?
lines.zh: : 那是什么感觉？

lines.en: : Uhh...Shota? When I said I wanted to talk, I...didn’t mean about that.
lines.zh: : 呃……Shota？我说想聊聊的时候，我……不是指聊这个。

lines.en: : Oh. What did you mean, then?
lines.zh: : 哦。那你指的是什么？

lines.en: scene knifeboy18
: Sana Sakakibara spent the next three hours talking to Knife Boy about everything that’s changed in her life.
lines.zh: Sana Sakakibara 接下来的三个小时都在和小刀男孩讲她生活里发生的所有变化。

lines.en: : She even caved and confessed about how she’d been experimenting sexually lately, but wasn’t sure just how appropriate it was since she was pretty sure her brother stopped aging after death (as one does).
lines.zh: 她甚至松口坦白了自己最近在做性方面的尝试，只是不太确定说出来合不合适，因为她相当确定哥哥在死后就停止 aging 了（人死了都这样）。

lines.en: : Knife Boy didn’t speak much. He was worried that more sharp objects would be slid into his body.
lines.zh: 小刀男孩话不多。他怕会有更多尖锐的物体被滑进他的身体。

lines.en: : It was roughly thirteen minutes later that Sana decided to try and remove one. To the surprise of both of them, it came out smoothly and without pain. And no other knives appeared to take its place.
lines.zh: 大约十三分钟后，Sana 决定试着拔掉一把。出乎他们两个的意料，它顺滑地出来了，而且不疼。也没有别的刀出现来顶替它的位置。

lines.en: : It was a good day for Knife Boy. He could finally be freed from the constant stabbing pains that resulted from all of the times he’d been stabbed.
lines.zh: 对小刀男孩来说，这是美好的一天。他终于能从那些因被刺而不断产生的刺痛中解脱了。

lines.en: : And it was a good day for Sana too since she’d finally get to see her brother. Or at least...something that harbored the soul of her brother and wasn’t obscured by tools of destruction.
lines.zh: 对 Sana 来说也是美好的一天，因为她终于能见到哥哥了。或者至少……某个承载了她哥哥灵魂、又没被破坏工具遮蔽的东西。

lines.en: : He looked significantly paler since the last time she saw him. And that’s saying a lot since the last time she saw him he was literally dead.
lines.zh: 他比她上次见到时苍白了许多。而这么说分量可不轻，因为她上次见到他时，他可是字面意义上的死了。

lines.en: : And I guess he still is literally dead. But he’s dead in a lively way. Maybe. It was still up in the air, but the bright side of being under a ceiling-painted sky is that the air didn’t go on forever.
lines.zh: 而我猜他现在也还是字面意义上的死了。只不过他死得很有生气。也许吧。这事还悬着，不过待在一片画在天上的天花板下的好处是，空气不会永远延伸下去。

lines.en: : In here, there was no chance to escape. That air only moved in circles. It had nowhere else to go.
lines.zh: 在这里，没有逃脱的可能。那空气只会在原地打圈。它没有别的地方可去。

lines.en: : Or at least that’s what Sana believed at first.
lines.zh: 至少 Sana 一开始是这么相信的。

lines.en: scene knifeboy27
But as she removed knife after knife after knife after knife from her brother’s body, she came closer to the unfortunate truth that removing {i}all{/i} of them was a {i}bad{/i} thing.
lines.zh: 但当她一把又一把、一把又一把地从哥哥身上拔出刀时，她越来越接近一个不幸的真相：把它们{i}全{/i}拔出来是件{i}坏{/i}事。

lines.en: : Shota?...
lines.zh: : Shota？……

lines.en: : Shota?...Hello?...
lines.zh: : Shota？……喂？……

lines.en: : You’re still with me, right? You’re still there?! Shota?!
lines.zh: : 你还在吧？你还在那儿对吧？！Shota？！

lines.en: You see, without knives, there can be no Knife Boy. So the legend that kept him anchored to this realm went poof and, with it, vanished the one non-living male Sana had any amount of feelings for.
lines.zh: 你看，没有刀，就没有小刀男孩。于是那个把他锚定在这个领域的传说「噗」的一声没了，随之消失的，是 Sana 唯一一个对她有那么点感情的、非活着的男性。

lines.en: scene knifeboy28
: Shota! Say something! Please! I don’t want you to go yet!
lines.zh: : Shota！说点什么！求你了！我还不想让你走！

lines.en: Too late! He is gone. But the bright side is that Sana had already navigated every stage of grief that resulted from his initial passing, so this one probably wouldn’t be that bad.
lines.zh: 太迟了！他走了。不过好消息是，Sana 在他初次离世时已经走遍了悲伤的每一个阶段，所以这一次大概不会那么糟。

lines.en: scene knifeboy29
Oh?
: ...Shota?
lines.zh: : ……Shota？

lines.en: His shell began to crack and chip as the flood pouring from his sister’s eyes encountered an imaginary beaver working at the speed of light to erect a dam near her irises.
lines.zh: 他的外壳开始龟裂、剥落，而从妹妹眼里涌出的洪水，遇上一只以光速在她虹膜附近筑坝的想象中的海狸。

lines.en: : Is...everything okay?...
lines.zh: : 一切……都还好吗？……

lines.en: scene knifeboy30
: Are...Are you coming back to life?! Was removing the knives all it took to bring you back?! Can we get out of here together now?! Did I do a good job?!
lines.zh: : 你……你要复活了吗？！把刀拔出来就足以让你回来吗？！我们现在能一起离开这儿了吗？！我做得好吗？！

lines.en: : I can’t wait to introduce you to everyone! Ayane is amazing. And we have this whole group that plays D&D and- actually. Before I forget, stay away from Kirin. Okay? She’ll...hurt you. Let’s just say that.
lines.zh: : 我等不及要把你介绍给大家了！Ayane 超棒的。我们还有一整个玩 D&D 的小组，还有——对了，趁我没忘，离 Kirin 远点。好吗？她会……伤害你。就这么说吧。

lines.en: scene knifeboy29
: There’s that sound again. Are you just a big, human-shaped egg? Because I {i}thought{/i} your skin felt kind of weird, but-
lines.zh: : 又是那个声音。你该不会是个巨大的人形蛋吧？因为我{i}觉得{/i}你的皮肤摸起来有点怪，不过——

lines.en: scene knifeboy31
He has hatched!
lines.zh: : 他孵化了！

lines.en: scene knifeboy32
: Sensei?...
: {i}Sensei?{/i}
scene knifeboy33
: So you’re telling me you have no idea how you got here?
lines.zh: : 所以你是说，你完全不知道自己是怎么到这儿来的？

lines.en: : Yeah...so if you happen to know the way out-
lines.zh: : 是啊……所以如果你碰巧知道出去的路——

lines.en: scene knifeboy34
: Oh...no. I’m in the same boat. One minute, I was going for a walk. The next, I was getting hit on by a horse with two heads and...pulling knives out of my brother’s...ghost...thing?
lines.zh: : 哦……不。我也是一样的处境。上一分钟我还在散步，下一分钟我就被一匹长着两个头的马搭讪，然后……从我哥哥的……鬼魂……什么的身上拔刀？

lines.en: : You don’t think we might’ve...{i}died,{/i} do you?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我们有没有可能……{i}已经死了{/i}？

lines.en: : If we did, Heaven’s way weirder than I would have expected. Which...isn’t to say I really expect it {i}at all.{/i} It’s just that this...has that sort of “afterlife” feel to it. You know?
lines.zh: : 如果真死了，那天堂可比我想象的奇怪多了。虽然……我也并没有{i}真的{/i}想象过它。只是这里……有那种“来世”的感觉。你懂吧？

lines.en: : Yeah...
: You’re really sure you don’t know who I am?
lines.zh: : 你真的确定不认识我？

lines.en: : I mean...you called me “Sensei” earlier, so...maybe you’re not far off? Like...we don’t...go to school together, do we? We look about the same age, so...
lines.zh: : 我是说……你刚才叫我“老师”，所以……也许你猜得不算离谱？比如……我们……不是一起上学的吧？我们看起来年纪差不多，所以……

lines.en: scene knifeboy35
: I’m actually in high school.
lines.zh: : 我其实在上高中。

lines.en: scene knifeboy36
: Really?! But you look so-
lines.zh: : 真的？！可你看起来好——

lines.en: : Ah! Remember to be polite when you’re speaking to upperclassmen. I might look small, but I’m actually your onee-san.
lines.zh: : 啊！跟学长学姐说话记得要有礼貌。我看着小，但我其实是你的 onee-san。

lines.en: : I’m sorry! I really had no idea!
lines.zh: : 对不起！我真的不知道！

lines.en: scene knifeboy37
: It’s fine. Don’t worry about it. I just don’t get many chances to tease you, so I figured I’d jump on this one.
lines.zh: : 没事。别放在心上。我只是很少有机会逗你，所以就想抓住这次机会。

lines.en: : So you’re...really positive you know me then? In...the real world or...wherever we’re supposed to be right now.
lines.zh: : 那你是……真的确定你认识我？在……现实世界里，或者……我们现在该在的随便什么地方。

lines.en: : I do...
lines.zh: : 是的……

lines.en: : And it might sound surprising hearing it like this, but...you’re actually a really important person to me.
lines.zh: : 而且这样听起来也许有点意外，但……你对我来说其实是个非常重要的人。
: 我……明白了……

lines.en: scene knifeboy38
: You don’t have a girlfriend, do you? Want to do some experimenting with a cool onee-san?
lines.zh: : 你没有女朋友吧？想和一位很酷的 onee-san 做点实验吗？

lines.en: : O-Oh...You’re one of {i}those{/i} types of girls.
lines.zh: : 哦、哦……你是{i}那种{/i}类型的女孩。

lines.en: scene knifeboy39
: What do you mean “one of those” types of girls?!
lines.zh: : “那种类型”的女孩是什么意思？！

lines.en: : Y-You know! The kind who...do {i}those{/i} things with...younger...
lines.zh: : 就、就是那种……和年纪小的……做{i}那种{/i}事的……

lines.en: : A-Anyway! I do have a girlfriend! A really pretty one too! With...pretty eyes and...long hair and...she’s real, okay?!
lines.zh: : 总、总之！我有女朋友！而且很漂亮！有……漂亮的眼睛和……长头发，而且……她是真的，好吗？！

lines.en: scene knifeboy40
: Pfft. Sounds super believable, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 噗。听着超级可信呢，老师。

lines.en: : I mean it! And stop calling me that! My name is Akira!
lines.zh: : 我是认真的！还有别那么叫我！我叫 Akira！

lines.en: : Well, it’s nice to “meet” you, Akira.
lines.zh: : 那么，很“高兴”认识你，Akira。

lines.en: scene knifeboy41
: My name is-
lines.zh: : 我叫——

lines.en: scene knifeboy42
: Ah.
: O, infinite spring — your song ever sweet. How intimate, poignant, and true.
lines.zh: : 哦，无尽的春天——你的歌永远甜美。多么亲密、多么尖锐、又多么真实。

lines.en: : How it blurs every line, every thought that we think — and brings me right back here to you.
lines.zh: : 它模糊了每一条线、我们所想的每一个念头——把我径直带回你身边。

lines.en: : {i}Kaori?...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Kaori？……{/i}

lines.en: scene knifeboy43
: So it’s you today.
lines.zh: : 今天是你啊。

lines.en: : What’s...{i}me{/i} today? And what...happened to your eyes?
lines.zh: : 什么……是{i}我{/i}今天？还有你的眼睛……怎么了？

lines.en: : For what reason did you stray from the two-headed horse?
lines.zh: : 你为何从双头马身边走开了？

lines.en: : Did his elevator pitch never reach the floor of your choice?
lines.zh: : 难道他的电梯推销没能抵达你选的楼层？

lines.en: : The...Pegasus...thing? I just thought it was creepy. But things like that...they keep showing up. And it isn’t always him, it’s-
lines.zh: : 那个……Pegasus……东西？我只是觉得它很恶心。但那种东西……它们一直出现。而且不总是他，还有——

lines.en: : Is it the {i}idea{/i} of God you despise? Or have you simply not found the right one?
lines.zh: : 你厌恶的是神这个{i}概念{/i}？还是你只是还没找到对的那一位？

lines.en: : I don’t...
lines.zh: : 我不……

lines.en: : Kaori...what’s going on? Where are we?...
lines.zh: : Kaori……到底怎么回事？我们在哪儿？……

lines.en: : Are you actually here?...Or is this just another thing I’m making up right now?...
lines.zh: : 你真的在这里吗？……还是说这又是我现在编出来的另一个东西？……

lines.en: : I could ask you the same question.
lines.zh: : 我也可以问你同样的问题。

lines.en: scene knifeboy44
: Your wish was admirable — but your subsequent actions when saving Knife Boy leave much to be desired.
lines.zh: : 你的愿望值得称许——但你随后拯救小刀男孩的行动，就有待商榷了。

lines.en: : There are some rules that must be followed at all costs. Which means that those who break those rules must be punished severely or everyone else would break them too.
lines.zh: : 有些规矩是必须不惜一切代价遵守的。也就是说，破坏规矩的人必须受到严厉惩罚，否则其他人也会跟着破坏。

lines.en: : Today, you felt but a taste of what comes when you color outside of the lines.
lines.zh: : 今天，你只是尝到了越界的滋味。

lines.en: : But I hope that, in the future, you’ll do better.
